title: Not Enough
text: "You have shown us the parcels. You have not shown us why. Without the why, a win is still a win."

lines.text: "We like you. That is not evidence. We are sorry. Please go now."

choices.label: Take down the cores
choices.reply: Three cores round the well light up on your display. So do the guns round them.

choices.label: Leave Rime
choices.reply: You pull back from the well. Under the ice, Engram goes on thinking about winning.

tags: act 2, engram, rime, doubled, fight, choice
notes: Rare: engram ≥ 3 but no Ledger (only reachable by jumping to the mission; rime-route needs ledger-read). Engram doubles down all the same.
